add.title: Antigua and Barbuda | Outright International
add.summary: Thin: Outright International country profile (page states 'Last Update: March 12, 2026'; fetched and subject-verified). The Eastern Caribbean Supreme Court's 2022 ruling struck down Sections 12 and 15 of the Sexual Offences Act 1995, and read the constitutional bar on sex discrimination as inclusive of sexual orientation and gender identity; there are still no explicit anti-discrimination protections, same-sex unions are unrecognised, and transgender people are particularly vulnerable because no legal gender recognition mechanism exists. The profile contains no data on trans-prisoner housing placement (birth-sex vs identity placement), special units, or solitary/segregation practice for Antigua and Barbuda.
